_comment_family: The heavy half of expulsion-science's pair, and the half that
already had a name of its own. See the note in montserrat-bold.json,
which this pack is the counterpart of and which covers all three of
the Montserrat cuts in this folder.
An ExtraBold is not one of the four styles the old family model has
room for, so the static build gives it a family of its own: name ID 1
here reads 'Montserrat ExtraBold' with 'Regular' as the subfamily,
and the real family shows up only in the typographic names (16/17) as
'Montserrat' + 'ExtraBold'. Declaring the full name is therefore not a
workaround on this side of the pair - it is the file's own family
name, and montserrat-semibold is in exactly the same position at the
other end. It is declared that way on all three so they read as one
decision rather than as some packs being careful and others not.

_comment_css: Not declared in styles.css: this face arrived with a channel and is
registered from this JSON, which is the route content/README.md

_comment_local: What the machine may already know the face by, tried after the file.
The first is the Windows full name and the second the PostScript
name; both name this one cut rather than the family, so a machine
answering to either is answering with the ExtraBold - which is the
whole of what this face is for.
'Montserrat' on its own is absent here for the reason it is absent
next door, and the consequence is sharper on this side: a highlight
that fell back to the family would be picked words set in whatever
weight the machine keeps as Montserrat's default, which on most
machines is the Regular - a highlight lighter than the block it is
supposed to be picked out of.
